jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Come and build innovative services that protect our cloud from advanced security threats!  

  

As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you’ll help build and manage services that detect and automate the mitigation of cybersecurity threats across Amazon’s infrastructure, including advanced persistent threats. You’ll work with security engineers, data scientists, and other software development engineers across multiple teams to develop innovative security solutions at a massive scale. Our services protect the AWS cloud for all customers and help preserve our customers’ trust in us. You’ll get to use the full power and breadth of AWS technologies to build services that proactively protect every single AWS customer, both internally and externally, from security threats – not many teams can say that!  

  

We’re looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers. We want someone who will help us amplify the positive and inclusive team culture we’ve been building.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Software Development Engineer, you will leverage Amazon technology (Lambda, Kinesis, DynamoDB, etc.) to solve AWS Security problems at staggering scale. You will raise the bar on our software architecture and development practices. You will share ownership of our operational excellence, ensuring our system is properly tuned and has appropriate alarms for warning or error conditions. You will help drive our working backwards processes, inventing and simplifying on behalf of our customers. You will build security detections that identify specific security issues and automatically help customers reduce their risk through network and security controls.  

  

On\-Call Responsibility  

This position involves on\-call responsibilities, typically for one week every few weeks. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.  

  

A day in the life  

* Collaborate with data scientists and security engineers to build automated security detection and mitigation workflows
* Design scalable architectures for low\-latency, big data processing
* Improve the observability, performance, and efficiency of our existing systems
* Raise the bar for testing, repeatability, automation, and operational excellence
* Mentor and develop teammates, both technically and professionally
* Seek out, develop, and advocate for new technologies

  

About the team  

Why Amazon Security?  

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  

  

Training \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

On\-Call Responsibility  

This position involves on\-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience (non\-internship) in professional software development
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience (non\-internship) software development in a combination of any of the following languages: Java, C\#, Python, or Rust. TypeScript is a plus.
* Experience working with Linux operating system development

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
* Experience working in backend software engineering applications that process large datasets such as network flow logs or security telemetry.

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Supply Chain Management Technology (all genders)
jobs.description:
About the role: What's in the Box

As a Staff Engineer in our Supply Chain Management organization, you will be responsible for defining, securing, and implementing technical solutions for business problems. You will play a critical role as our systems scale to handle a jump from 1.2 million to over 2.4 million produced boxes per week due to recent software product consolidation. You will look after speeding up development, decision-making, and problem-solving. You will work with our neighboring teams to ensure that our efforts aim to achieve a clearer architecture and boundaries between tech teams to support autonomy. You will communicate directly with our business stakeholders and multiple tech teams supporting local markets. You will report to the Director of Engineering in the Production tribe. This role does not include people management responsibilities.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

Assume technical leadership within a tribe and own the most challenging tech decisions, including architecture, design, development, deployment, and operational excellence.
Support the teams in the architectural design and help to maintain architectural integrity in the scope of the tribe and beyond.
Spend a significant portion of your time orchestrating code generation—guiding AI coding agents, rigorously reviewing their implementations, and refining logic based on organization needs.
Solve software problems that have visible risks, roadblocks, and constraints. You will navigate an environment that is approximately 70% greenfield development and 30% legacy systems, managing dependencies, data quality, compliance, and architectural transformations.
Mentor more junior engineers by fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

Ideally, 10+ years of engineering experience, including 2+ years in a staff/principal level capacity and technical leadership.
Strong capability in working with different stakeholders and experience addressing physical world problems with software solutions.
Full-Stack & Agentic Engineering: Deep problem-solving skills and full-stack proficiency (e.g., C#, Python, Golang, and modern frontend technologies). You bring hands-on experience leveraging AI coding agents (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code) in production, moving beyond basic prompting to master context engineering, workflow decomposition, and the implementation of strict guardrails for reliable agent outputs.
Experience with data engineering fundamentals is highly desirable, including expertise in data modeling, governance, quality assurance, and proficiency in data processing and storage systems.
Expertise in designing and implementing modular systems, including proficiency in synchronous/asynchronous communication.
A team player attitude and a passion for helping others grow through peer-to-peer mentoring, knowledge-sharing sessions, and advocating for best engineering practices, such as CI/CD, TDD, BDD, DDD, and Design Patterns.
An agile mindset with the ability to advocate for cross-functional collaboration.

Interacting with front-end developers, designers, product managers and our teams around the world is very much part of our day-to-day, so communication skills are vital. We are looking for strong problem-solvers who can apply their engineering skills to a wide range of platforms and environments, while also acting as an ambassador to coach team members and stakeholders.

What we offer: The Toppings

You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.
Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.
Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.
Stay active with a discounted Urban Sports Club membership and other wellbeing resources.
Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.
Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.

Are you the missing ingredient?
If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

The Role

Location:
Reigate / Hybrid

Reports to:
Mark Mamone

Peer relationships:
Head of Architecture, Platform & Engineering Enablement leadership, and Stack Engineering Leaders across ICT

WTW is seeking a technically credible engineering leader to mature and scale engineering capability across ICT. This is not a traditional Director of Engineering role: there are no direct reports. Instead, it is a strategic, deeply technical role focused on improving engineering consistency, software delivery maturity and effectiveness across five autonomous engineering stacks. They should be capable of being hands-on, for the purposes of reinforcing their strategic direction in the space of DevEx and being credible and authentic in the face of technical professionals.

The stacks have been given autonomy to improve delivery velocity. The next phase retains that autonomy while introducing the right level of shared practice, tooling consistency and technical governance. Success depends on technical depth and the ability to build consensus — influencing engineering decisions through credibility and evidence rather than formal authority, and being willing to roll up sleeves and get into technical and code-level problems when it helps move things forward.

Their scope is to ensure that, across 400+ technical professionals dispersed into teams aligned to Products, they are able to reinforce modern best practices — especially in an agentic world — and bring the teams along a journey to a more consistent, modern, AI-native software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering practice & SDLC maturity: raise the quality and consistency of software design, development, testing and delivery; improve route-to-live, release management, quality gates and CI/CD; reduce manual effort where automation adds value.
Technical governance & consensus: provide constructive, hands-on challenge to engineering and architecture decisions; build alignment across stacks while respecting differing product, commercial and lifecycle needs; support pragmatic technical-debt strategies.
Tooling & developer experience: assess and improve developer experience; standardise and consolidate tooling where it creates clear value (including the move to GitHub as a strategic platform).
AI adoption across the SDLC: drive practical adoption of AI-enabled engineering across development, testing, review, documentation and support, aligned to governance and measurable outcomes.
Engineering metrics & insight: improve visibility of delivery health using frameworks such as DORA and the LinearB pilot; define WTW-specific “lighthouse metrics” that reflect real effectiveness, not activity.
Shared engineering capability: reduce duplication across stacks; promote reusable components, patterns and common engineering services where appropriate.

Technology Environment

The environment uses, or is moving towards: C#, .NET / .NET Core, Microsoft Azure, GitHub (an increasingly strategic platform), Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines and automation, and engineering analytics tooling including the LinearB pilot. The candidate should understand these well enough to challenge, guide and directly contribute to engineering direction.

What Success Looks Like

Greater consistency in engineering practices and stronger technical alignment across stacks.
Improved SDLC maturity, better CI/CD and reduced manual effort, through the adoption of AI, automation and other mechanisms
Better developer experience and pragmatic tooling standardisation where it adds value.
Clearer engineering metrics and improved visibility of delivery health.
Increased reuse of engineering capability and greater adoption of AI-enabled practices.
A healthy balance between stack autonomy and organisational consistency.

Qualifications

What you’ll bring

This role suits a technical CTO-style leader who succeeds through credibility, judgement and consensus rather than line authority — and who stays close enough to the methodologies associated with software engineering and where necessary, the code, to challenge, guide and, when needed, get directly involved in solving technical problems.

Strong technical depth: able to hold their own with Stack Engineering Leaders and dive into architecture, code and delivery detail when it adds value.
A natural consensus-builder: challenges decisions constructively, aligns strong personalities, and creates momentum without unnecessary friction.
An excellent communicator who can simplify complex engineering topics for any audience.
Outcome-focused, pragmatic and comfortable balancing consistency with stack autonomy.

Essential technical experience across several of modern software engineering practices; enterprise-scale delivery and SDLC optimisation; CI/CD and deployment automation; cloud-native engineering; application architecture and technical design; secure, quality-led delivery; engineering metrics; technical-debt management; and AI adoption within engineering.

Background & Industry

There is no rigid career blueprint; breadth is an advantage. Relevant backgrounds include engineering, architecture, platform or developer-experience leadership; DevOps or cloud transformation; and CTO / VP / Staff Engineering roles. The common thread is solving complex engineering challenges across multiple teams and stakeholders. Experience in regulated environments (financial services, insurance, banking, consulting, enterprise SaaS) is highly beneficial given the need for governance, quality and control. Insurance experience is beneficial but not essential.

What We Offer

Enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive, both professionally and personally. You'll receive 25 days of annual leave plus an extra WTW day to relax and recharge. Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company.

We support your growth and balance with hybrid working options, access to an employee assistance programme, and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community. On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including an electric vehicle car scheme, share scheme, cycle-to-work programme, dental and optical cover, critical illness protection, and much more. Start making the most of your career and wellbeing with a range of benefits tailored for you.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Head of Engineering – Financial Services | £150,000 + Bonus + Benefits | Paddington, London – 4 Days Office

A leading organisation within the financial services sector
is undergoing a major technology transformation, modernising its core trading, data, and analytics platforms. With significant investment into its technology function, the business is building a next-generation platform to support data-driven decision making and improve the way its trading teams operate.

As part of this transformation, the organisation is seeking a Head of Engineering
to lead a growing technology function across software development, data engineering and QA
. This is a senior engineering leadership position with responsibility for technical direction, engineering standards, delivery and team development.

The Opportunity

This is a key leadership role for an experienced engineering leader who enjoys working in a hands-on, technically complex environment. You will lead the engineering function while remaining close to the technology, working with developers, data engineers and QA engineers to deliver high-quality platforms supporting the firm's financial services and trading activities.
You will take ownership of engineering strategy and delivery, helping shape the architecture, development practices and technology roadmap. You will work closely with senior stakeholders across technology and the business to ensure the engineering function continues to support the firm's trading and commercial objectives.

The platform will process and integrate large volumes of data, supporting teams across trading, risk, analytics and operations
. You will have the opportunity to shape a modern engineering function and play a key role in the ongoing transformation of the firm's technology estate.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and develop the engineering function across Software Development, Data Engineering and QA
.
• Own the engineering strategy, technical direction and delivery of critical technology across the firm's financial services and trading platforms.
• Build and maintain a high-performing engineering team, supporting recruitment, development, mentoring and progression.
• Provide technical leadership across architecture, software development, data platforms, testing and system integration.
• Work closely with senior technology and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
• Oversee the development of applications, APIs, microservices and data platforms supporting financial services and trading.
• Establish and maintain strong engineering standards around code quality, testing, deployment and documentation.
• Drive the adoption of modern development practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, cloud technologies and DevOps.
• Ensure close collaboration between developers, data engineers and QA throughout the development lifecycle.
• Help shape the long-term architecture and technology roadmap as the organisation continues its modernisation programme.
• Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, creating a strong culture of ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement.

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience leading an engineering function or large engineering team within a complex technology environment.
• Strong background in software engineering, ideally with experience across development, data engineering and QA
.
• Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, microservices and data platforms.
• Experience with C#/.NET would be highly advantageous.
• Strong understanding of cloud technologies, DevOps, CI/CD and automated testing.
• Experience building and developing high-performing engineering teams.
• Comfortable operating at both a strategic and technical level, with the ability to engage with engineers as well as senior business stakeholders.
• Experience working with complex data environments or high-volume, real-time systems.
• Financial services, capital markets, trading or commodities experience would be highly advantageous.

• A strong communicator who can provide clear technical direction while giving engineering teams the autonomy to deliver.

Compensation
: Up to £150,000 + Bonus + Benefits
Location
: Paddington, London
Working Pattern
: 4 days per week in the office

If you’re an experienced engineering leader looking to take ownership of a growing technology function at the heart of a financial services organisation
, send your CV to Joe@virtuetech.io or reply.

Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together.

At Susquehanna International Group, our technologists play a critical role in shaping the future of electronic trading. We build high-performance systems designed to compete in some of the most demanding and latency-sensitive markets in the world. Our developers collaborate closely with quantitative researchers and infrastructure teams to solve complex technical and strategic problems that drive significant business impact.

We are looking for a full-stack developer with strong proficiency in C#/.NET to join a fast-paced, iterative development team delivering business-critical systems. This role suits a pragmatic technologist who understands end-to-end system impact, communicates clearly, and delivers business value quickly without compromising long-term stability.

Successful candidates balance technical excellence with practical decision-making, take ownership of their work, and collaborate closely with both technical and business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain robust full-stack applications using C#/.NET and related technologies
Operate in an iterative development environment using lightweight specifications and fast feedback loops
Collaborate closely with traders, business users, support teams, and fellow developers
Contribute to system and application architecture with a focus on scalability, resilience, and performance
Take ownership of systems across the full lifecycle, from requirements and design through to production support
Support production environments at 2nd level, ensuring system stability and prioritising operational improvements
Participate actively in design discussions, reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions
Apply pragmatic decision-making guided by speed, capacity, stability, and risk

What We're Looking For

Skills and Experience

Proficiency in C#/.NET and WPF
Experience in at least one additional programming language (e.g. Python or JavaScript)
Solid understanding of software design, debugging, and problem solving
Experience working with distributed systems and business-critical applications
Familiarity with modern development tools and practices (e.g. Git-based workflows, CI/CD)
Experience working across the full software development lifecycle, including production support
Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in collaborative, fast-moving environments

Personal Attributes

Pragmatic and delivery-focused, without sacrificing code quality or long-term maintainability
Strong sense of ownership and accountability
Clear, concise communicator with good judgment on when and how to engage others
Curious, adaptable, and motivated to understand both technical systems and business context

Nice to Have

Experience in financial, trading, or time-sensitive environments
Exposure to cloud platforms, containerisation, or system monitoring
Experience with databases and writing complex queries

jobs.title: .NET Automation/Machine Vision Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Multivative ist ein österreichisches Startup und das Technologieunternehmen hinter Pick2Place. Wir fertigen Elektronik-Prototypen für Entwicklungsteams in ganz Europa und zeigen, dass schnelles, flexibles und kostengünstiges Prototyping auch hier möglich ist. Der Schlüssel dazu ist Automatisierung: Ein Prototyp wird online mit wenigen Klicks bestellt, unsere Software und selbstentwickelten Maschinen übernehmen den Großteil der Arbeit, und ein paar Tage später liegt die fertige Platine beim Kunden. Wir sind ein kleines technisches Team in Vorarlberg und Graz und bauen fast alles selbst, von der Weboberfläche bis zur Bestückungsmaschine. Wir stehen noch am Anfang, wachsen aber schnell, und unser Ziel ist klar: der führende Elektronik-Prototypenfertiger in Europa zu werden.

Aufgaben

Du entwickelst die Software unserer Bestückungs- und Inspektionsmaschinen weiter: Bewegungssteuerung, Bildverarbeitung, Kalibrierung (C#, .NET).
Du baust und verbesserst unsere Machine-Vision-Pipeline, von der Kameraansteuerung und Beleuchtung bis zur Bauteilerkennung und optischen Inspektion.
Du bringst ML-Modelle vom Prototyp in den Produktionsbetrieb und sorgst dafür, dass sie an der Maschine zuverlässig laufen.
Du triffst Architekturentscheidungen selbstständig und übernimmst Verantwortung für die technische Umsetzung.
Du setzt AI-Tools im Alltag ein, um schneller und besser zu entwickeln.
Du stehst regelmäßig an der Maschine, testest direkt an der Hardware und arbeitest eng mit unserem Mechanik- und Elektronikteam zusammen.

Qualifikationen

Erfahrung mit C# und .NET, idealerweise in der Ansteuerung von Hardware oder in Echtzeit-nahen Anwendungen.
Grundlagen in Bildverarbeitung oder Machine Vision (OpenCV, Kamerasysteme, Beleuchtung). Erfahrung mit ML-basierter Erkennung ist ein Plus, kein Muss.
Ein gutes Gefühl für Architektur. Du kannst begründen, warum du dich für eine Lösung entscheidest.
Freude daran, mit echter Hardware zu arbeiten. Wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, gehst du zur Maschine und schaust nach.
Du nutzt LLMs und Coding-Agents selbstverständlich in deiner Arbeit und hast Lust, das weiter auszureizen.
Du willst in einem wachsenden Startup mitwachsen, Verantwortung übernehmen und Dinge selbst in die Hand nehmen.
Deutsch oder Englisch, beides ist bei uns im Alltag.

Du musst nicht alle Punkte abhaken. Ein motivierter Engineer, der schnell lernt und wirklich etwas bauen will, ist uns wichtiger als ein perfekter Lebenslauf.

Benefits

Home-Office
Firmenlaptop
Flexible Arbeitszeiten
Öffi-Ticket
Weiterbildung
